text:
anna: quick sync — console requested per-model/route SLO dashboards (P50/P95/P99, TTFT, tokens/sec). Need runtime & infra inputs. Goal: canary in 2 weeks. Thoughts?

chris: +1. we need label set from runtime: model_id, route, variant, seq_len_bucket. also kv_cache_hit boolean? TTFT needs a hook at first-token emit (not request start).

sophia: telemetry ingest cost concern. raw tokens/sec at 100% will be heavy. propose sampling 1% across steady traffic and 100% for canaries / enterprise tenants. also retention for p99 windows?

mike: console UX: want per-route dropdown, heatmap for P95 spikes, and ability to filter by rollout tag (canary / stable). derived metrics: tokens/sec (1m/5m) + rolling TTFT trend. also need model friendly names from registry.

chris: example prom query for tokens/sec:
```
sum(rate(tokens_emitted_total{model=~".*",route=~".*"}[1m])) by (model,route)
```
We should emit tokens_emitted_total from runtime with labels.

anna: ownership proposal: runtime adds labels + TTFT histogram & tokens counter; infra handles sampling, ingestion and metrics schema; console builds dashboard & filters. product provides model registry mapping. OK?

sophia: question: do we emit TTFT as histogram buckets (prefer) or summaries? histograms allow rollups at ingest. propose buckets: [0.005,0.01,0.03,0.1,0.3,1.0,3.0] seconds. also we should tag whether request used cached KV to explain tail behavior.

chris: histograms SGTM. we'll add labels: model, route, variant, route_version, fallback_reason, seq_len_bucket, kv_cache_hit. buckets as sophia suggested. tokens_emitted_total as counter. want to include sample_rate label so infra can downsample properly.

mike: for dashboard panels:
- per-model/route P50/P95/P99 (TTFT histograms)
- TTFT distribution heatmap by seq_len_bucket
- tokens/sec timeseries + 1m/5m overlays
- alerting: P99 TTFT > 1s for 5m for production routes
Need a wireframe by Tue so Console PM can review.

anna: action items and timeline:
- runtime: implement histogram + tokens counter + labels, add first-token hook (target: EOD Fri)
- infra: design sampling & ingestion schema, define retention & rollup windows (target: Wed)
- console: wireframes for panels & filters (target: Tue)
- SRE/sophia: cost estimate & canary plan (target: Wed)
- product: share model registry API + friendly name mapping (target: Thu)

ci-bot: deploy: runtime/telemetry/schema created at commit abc123, tests passed.

sophia: noted. early estimate: +12% ingest at 1% sampling baseline due to histograms; full 100% would be much higher. Will post a detailed breakdown.

chris: one more: routing fallbacks and multi-tier routing will skew P99. we need to tag route_version and fallback_reason in all telemetry so dashboards can attribute spikes to routing policy changes.

anna: good call. include route_version + fallback_reason as required labels.

mike: can we show TTFT broken down by seq_len_bucket and variant in the UI? that's very helpful for debugging.

anna: yes — console will add multi-select for seq_len_bucket + variant.

chris: also recommend adding a sample-tag for trace_id when sampling so we can link traces back for tail investigations.

anna: thanks everyone — I'll follow up with a calendar invite for a 30m handoff once runtime infra has first PRs. @mike please link wireframes when ready. :thumbsup:
